scoring_scale.90-100: 公開根拠が具体的で充実
scoring_scale.0-39: 明確な不足・矛盾を確認

rules.unverified: null; displayed as — and excluded from weighted score and category average
rules.verified_absence: may receive a low score only when the official page or policy has been reviewed sufficiently to establish that the feature or disclosure is absent; a failed search alone is not evidence of absence
rules.visual_quality: null for every site because no direct visual/browser screenshot audit was performed in this review.
rules.probability: do not infer draw probabilities from small samples or historical counts
rules.review_scope: All 29 listed sites reviewed against the same 16 criteria using official public pages and search-indexed official content on 2026-10-26.
rules.accessibility: score only explicit published keyboard/accessibility support; do not infer from semantic HTML or browser behavior without testing.
rules.responsive: score published responsive/mobile support only; do not claim measured layout quality without device testing.
rules.privacy: do not award high privacy scores merely because a policy exists; score only disclosed data handling and controls.
rules.score_precision: scores are rubric-based reviewer judgments, not measured percentages or objective probabilities.
rules.coverage: coverage is weighted evidence coverage; null items are excluded from denominator, but must be shown as unverified.

eligibility.reason: A lower threshold lets sparse public documentation produce an overconfident rank because unverified criteria are excluded from the denominator.
